scenarios.title: 机场租车：躲开推销，自己说了算
scenarios.setting: 你落地后到机场租车柜台取预订的车。工作人员 Kevin 热情得有点过头——升级、保险、各种附加包一个接一个。你赶时间，但不想为不需要的东西付钱。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Kevin (rental agent)
turns.en: Welcome! I have your booking — a compact for four days. For just twenty more a day I can put you in the SUV. Much safer on the coast road.
turns.zh: 欢迎！您的预订我这里有——四天的小型车。每天只多二十，我就能给您换成 SUV。海岸公路上安全多了。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你婉拒升级：小型车够用、四天行程都在城里和海边平路上，你不打算为用不上的空间和油耗买单。
turns.en: Thanks, but the compact is fine. We're staying on paved roads, and I'd rather keep the rental car cheap to fuel.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Kevin (rental agent)
turns.en: Fair enough. Now, insurance: your booking has basic cover. Our full package removes all excess. Most customers take it for peace of mind.
turns.zh: 那好。保险方面：您的预订只有基础险。我们的全包套餐免掉所有免赔额。大多数客人都买个安心。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你先问清自己已有什么：你的信用卡自带租车险、预订里也含第三方责任险，你只想确认缺口在哪，而不是重复买。
turns.en: Before I decide: my credit card covers collision, and the booking includes third-party insurance. What gap is actually left?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Kevin (rental agent)
turns.en: Honestly, just the excess on damage to our car — about a thousand. The full package zeroes it.
turns.zh: 老实说只剩一个缺口：我们车辆损坏的免赔额，大概一千。全包套餐能把它归零。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你算完账做决定：四天全包比一千免赔额便宜得多、这次买；同时确认油量政策，避免还车时被收一整箱油的钱。
turns.en: At that price, I'll take the full package for four days. One more thing: what's the fuel policy — full-to-full?

chunks.zh: 油量政策（租车满油借满油还之类）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Kevin (rental agent)
turns.en: Full-to-full, yes. Take a photo of the gauge when you leave. Returning to a different city adds a one-way fee of forty-five.
turns.zh: 是的，满油借满油还。出发时拍一下油表。异地还车要加四十五的单程费。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认行程不受影响：你本来就回这个机场还车，里程方面你要不限里程的费率，因为有一天要沿海岸开三百公里。
turns.en: We return here, so no one-way fee — same drop-off location as pickup. And I need the unlimited mileage rate: one day is a three-hundred-kilometer coast drive.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Kevin (rental agent)
turns.en: Done. Unlimited mileage included, return here by ten on Thursday. Keys, contract, and the photo tip — enjoy the coast.
turns.zh: 办好了。不限里程包含在内，周四十点前回到这里还车。钥匙、合同，还有记得拍油表——海岸玩得开心。

scenarios.title: 酒店房间：空调坏了，争取换房
scenarios.setting: 晚上十一点，你回到酒店房间发现空调只吹热风，房间闷得睡不着。你打电话到前台，接电话的是夜班员工 Sofia。你累但态度要坚定。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sofia (front desk)
turns.en: Front desk, this is Sofia. How can I help you?
turns.zh: 这里是前台，我是 Sofia。有什么可以帮您的？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说明问题：1206 房的空调只出热风，你试过遥控器所有模式，房间现在 29 度，今晚没法睡。
turns.en: Hi Sofia, this is room 1206 calling the front desk. The air conditioning only blows hot air. I've tried every mode; the room is twenty-nine degrees and I can't sleep in it.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sofia (front desk)
turns.en: I'm so sorry. I can send maintenance up, but at this hour it may take forty minutes, and they may not fix it tonight.
turns.zh: 非常抱歉。我可以派维修上来，但这个时间可能要四十分钟，而且今晚不一定修得好。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你提出你真正想要的方案：与其等维修，你希望直接换一间房，同楼层或者安静一点的都可以，你五分钟就能收拾好。
turns.en: Rather than wait for repairs, could I just move rooms? Same floor or anywhere quiet — I can pack in five minutes. And since we lose half the night moving, could we get a late checkout tomorrow?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sofia (front desk)
turns.en: Let me check... I have a room on the ninth floor, same type, and tonight I can upgrade you to an ocean-view room at no charge for the trouble.
turns.zh: 我查一下……九楼有一间同户型的，今晚我可以免费给您升级到海景房，算是补偿。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你接受并顺带把明天的安排一次说清：换房没问题；另外明早你想多睡一会儿，请挂请勿打扰、保洁不用进房，只要在门口多放两条毛巾。
turns.en: That works, thank you. Two favors for tomorrow: please leave the do not disturb on in the morning — housekeeping can skip us — and just leave extra towels at the door.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sofia (front desk)
turns.en: All noted. The new key card is coming up with the porter now. And breakfast is complimentary until ten, so no rush tomorrow.
turns.zh: 都记下了。新房卡正由行李员送上去。另外早餐免费供应到十点，明天不用赶。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认收尾：你下楼在大堂等行李员拿新卡，旧卡他回收；感谢她处理得痛快。
turns.en: Perfect — and a complimentary breakfast until ten means we can actually sleep in. I'll meet the porter downstairs with the old card. Thank you.

scenarios.title: 网红餐厅：订位、点菜、结账全流程
scenarios.setting: 旅行第三天，你想带家人去当地最有名的一家小馆子——不接受网上预订，只能打电话。你打过去，是老板娘 Rosa 接的。订完位，晚上你们准时到店。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rosa (owner)
turns.en: Buenas tardes, Casa Rosa. How can I help?
turns.zh: 下午好，这里是 Casa Rosa。有什么可以帮您？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你订今晚的位子：四个人、晚上七点半，提前说明有一位吃素食，希望靠窗安静一点的位置。
turns.en: Hello, I'd like to book a table for four tonight at seven thirty. One of us is vegetarian, and a quiet corner would be lovely if possible.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rosa (owner)
turns.en: Seven thirty is full, but I can do eight fifteen, near the garden. Name, please?
turns.zh: 七点半满了，八点十五可以，花园边上。可以给我个名字吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你接受八点一刻并留下名字和电话；确认一下迟到多久会取消留位。
turns.en: Eight fifteen works — please book a table under Zavier; my number ends in 0421. How long will you hold the table if we're late?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rosa (owner)
turns.en: (that evening) Welcome back! For drinks: still or sparkling water? And shall I tell you today's specials?
turns.zh: （当晚）欢迎回来！先喝点什么：普通水还是气泡水？要不要听听今天的特餐？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你要气泡水，然后请她直接推荐当地特色菜——你不想点游客菜单上的东西，套餐如果划算也可以。
turns.en: Sparkling, please. And we'd love the local specialty rather than the tourist menu. Is the set menu a good deal for four?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rosa (owner)
turns.en: The set menu feeds four with the stew, the grilled fish, and dessert for the price of two mains. The stew is what we're known for.
turns.zh: 套餐有炖菜、烤鱼和甜点，够四个人，价格等于两道主菜。那锅炖菜就是我们的招牌。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你拍板点套餐并照顾素食者：套餐来一份，其中一份主菜换成素食版；甜点里请避开坚果——你女儿对坚果过敏，这个要说清。
turns.en: We'll take the set menu, with one main swapped to the vegetarian version. And please, no nuts in the desserts — my daughter is allergic.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rosa (owner)
turns.en: (later) Everything okay? Whenever you're ready for the bill, just wave.
turns.zh: （后来）一切都好吗？想结账时招招手就行。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你结账并 AA：账单请分开打，你这份刷卡，另外两位付现金；小费你留在卡里一起付。
turns.en: Could we split the bill, please? Put mine on card — I'll add the tip there — and the other two will pay cash.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rosa (owner)
turns.en: Of course. Come back before you leave town — Thursdays we do the stew with seafood.
turns.zh: 当然。离城之前再来一次吧——周四的炖菜是海鲜版的。

scenarios.title: 买音乐剧票：选座、字幕、取票
scenarios.setting: 你在伦敦旅行，想带家人看一场音乐剧。热门场次网上只剩零星票，你直接到剧院售票处碰运气，售票员是 Tom。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tom (box office)
turns.en: Good afternoon. Which show can I help you with?
turns.zh: 下午好。您想看哪场演出？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你问今晚场次的余票：三个人，想坐得靠中间一点，预算每人八十镑以内；明晚也可以备选。
turns.en: Three tickets for tonight's show — I came straight to the box office hoping for central seats, up to eighty pounds each. Tomorrow night works as a backup.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tom (box office)
turns.en: Tonight is nearly sold out — I have three in the rear stalls at seventy-five, together. Tomorrow has better: row K, dead center, at eighty.
turns.zh: 今晚几乎售罄了——正厅后排有三个连座，七十五。明晚的更好：K 排正中间，八十。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你权衡后选明晚的好座位，并问清两个实际問題：演出有没有字幕屏（你母亲英文一般），以及票是现在取还是开演前取。
turns.en: Tonight being sold out settles it — let's take tomorrow, row K. Two questions: is there a subtitle screen for the songs? My mother's English is limited. And do I collect the tickets now or before the show?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tom (box office)
turns.en: There's a caption screen on the left for every performance. Collect anytime from six with the card you pay with. Running time is two hours forty, with one interval.
turns.zh: 每场左侧都有字幕屏。六点后凭付款的卡随时取票。演出时长两小时四十分，含一次中场休息。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认细节后付款：就这么定；如果明天家里有人来不了，这张票能不能退或者改期，你先问清规则再付钱。
turns.en: Perfect. Before I pay: if one of us can't make it tomorrow, can a ticket be exchanged for another date? I'll collect them at the box office before the show.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tom (box office)
turns.en: Exchanges yes, up to twenty-four hours before, small fee. Refunds no. Shall I put row K through?
turns.zh: 可以改期，提前二十四小时以上就行，收一点手续费。退票不行。K 排这就给您出票？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你点头付款，收好取票凭证，并确认入场时间建议。
turns.en: Yes, please. We'll arrive by seven — hoping for another standing ovation.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tom (box office)
turns.en: Exactly — doors at seven. Enjoy the show; that cast got a standing ovation last week.
turns.zh: 没错——七点开门入场。好好享受；这套卡司上周还赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

scenarios.title: 带娃去游乐园：身高、快速通道、找孩子
scenarios.setting: 周六，你带六岁的女儿去游乐园。入口处先买票，进园后直奔她心心念念的过山车。排队、规则、走散——一天的状况都在这儿了。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ticket staff
turns.en: Two adults and one child? The child ticket is half price today. The fast pass add-on is twenty per person.
turns.zh: 两位成人一位儿童？今天儿童票半价。快速通行证每人加二十。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你先问清快速通道到底值不值：它包含哪几个项目、大概省多少时间，今天热门项目的排队时长是多少。
turns.en: Half price for her is great. Before we decide on the fast pass: which rides does it cover, and how long are the queues today?

chunks.zh: 快速通行证（游乐园的免排队票）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ticket staff
turns.en: It covers the six biggest rides. The coaster is at ninety minutes right now; with the pass, about fifteen.
turns.zh: 它涵盖六个最大的项目。过山车现在排队九十分钟；用快速通道大概十五分钟。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你买了，并立刻确认女儿最想坐的过山车身高要求——她一百一十八厘米，你不想排到跟前才被拦下。
turns.en: We'll take it. One check: the big roller coaster — what's the height requirement? My daughter is a hundred and eighteen centimeters.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ride operator
turns.en: (at the coaster) She's just tall enough, great. Arms inside, and the bar locks down tight — ready?
turns.zh: （在过山车处）她刚好够高，太好了。手臂放里面，压杠会锁紧——准备好了吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你安抚有点紧张的女儿并确认规则：她可以坐你旁边，全程你都在；坐完这一趟如果她喜欢，下午用快速通道再免排队坐一次。
turns.en: She sits next to me the whole ride, right? Then this afternoon we can skip the line and ride it again if she loves it.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Park announcement / staff
turns.en: (later, at the service desk) You reported a lost child in the blue jacket near the carousel? She's here, drawing with our staff.
turns.zh: （后来，在服务台）您报告的穿蓝外套走失的小朋友在旋转木马附近找到的？她在这儿，正和我们员工画画呢。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你谢天谢地并确认孩子状态：先问她有没有受伤、受惊，确认平安后向工作人员道谢，并说你会把手环上的电话写得更清楚。
turns.en: Thank goodness. Is she okay — not hurt, not too scared? Thank you for keeping her calm. This amusement park just earned a loyal family. Next time I'll write my number bigger on her wristband.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Staff
turns.en: She's fine — she asked for ice cream twice, that's our medical clearance. Have a good rest of the day!
turns.zh: 她没事——她已经要了两次冰淇淋了，这就是我们的医学证明。今天剩下的时间玩得开心！

scenarios.title: 日落巡游 + 夜市：一晚的行程安排
scenarios.setting: 在海边城市的最后一个傍晚。你四点到码头售票处订今晚的日落巡游，之后打算去夜市吃晚饭。售票员 Mia 给了你不少本地建议。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Mia (ticket office)
turns.en: Hi! The sunset cruise boards at five, back by seven thirty. Two tickets are left for the top deck.
turns.zh: 您好！日落巡游五点登船，七点半回来。顶层甲板还剩两张票。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你订下顶层两张，并问清包含什么：饮料包不包、海上风大不大要不要带外套。
turns.en: We'll take the two top-deck seats for the sunset cruise. What's included — any drinks? And is it windy out there; should we bring jackets?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Mia (ticket office)
turns.en: One drink each is included. Bring a light jacket, the breeze picks up after sunset. After the cruise, skip the harbor restaurants — the night market two streets up is where locals eat.
turns.zh: 每人含一杯饮料。带件薄外套，日落后风会变大。巡游之后别去港口那些餐馆——往上两条街的夜市才是本地人吃饭的地方。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你记下建议并向她打听夜市攻略：哪个小吃摊最值得排队、几点去人最少、摊位收不收卡。
turns.en: Noted. At the night market, which food stall is worth the queue, and when is it least crowded? Do the stalls take cards?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Mia (ticket office)
turns.en: The noodle stall by the temple gate — forty years, one dish. Go after nine for shorter lines. Cash only, small bills. The grilled corn near the entrance is a hidden gem, too.
turns.zh: 寺庙门口那家面摊——四十年了，只卖一道菜。九点后去队短一点。只收现金，备小额钞票。入口附近的烤玉米也是个小众宝藏。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你在夜市摊位前实践：按她的推荐排队点单，要两份面、一份烤玉米，问清辣度，并强调一份不要香菜。
turns.en: (at the stall) Two bowls of the noodles and one grilled corn, please. One bowl not spicy, and no cilantro in either. Street food first night rules — follow the longest line.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Stall owner
turns.en: Two noodles, one mild, no cilantro, one corn. Eight minutes. Sit anywhere, I'll call your number.
turns.zh: 两份面，一份微辣，都不放香菜，一份玉米。八分钟。随便坐，我会叫号。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你道谢并感慨这一晚的安排，回头给 Mia 的建议打个满分。
turns.en: Perfect, thank you. This evening worked out exactly as planned — cruise at sunset, market after dark, and the corn really is a hidden gem. Best last night of the trip.

chunks.zh: 小众宝藏地（还没被游客发现的好地方）

scenarios.title: 护照丢了：警局报案 + 领事馆补证
scenarios.setting: 旅行第四天，你的包在地铁上被偷，护照、钱包都在里面。你先到最近的警察局报案，接待你的警官是 Officer Marek；拿到报案证明后，你又赶到领事馆。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Marek
turns.en: Good afternoon. You are here to report a theft? Tell me what happened, slowly.
turns.zh: 下午好。您是来报案失窃的吗？慢慢说，发生了什么。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你把事情讲清楚：下午两点在地铁二号线，包从你脚边被拽走，里面有护照、钱包和相机；你要报案主要是为了保险和补证件。
turns.en: Yes, I need to report a theft. Around two this afternoon, on metro line two, my bag was taken from beside my feet. It had my passport, wallet, and camera. I need the report for insurance and for replacing my documents.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Marek
turns.en: We will make the police report now. Do you have any copy of the passport? A photo on your phone helps us and the consulate.
turns.zh: 我们现在就做报案记录。您有护照的任何复印件吗？手机里的照片对我们和领事馆都有帮助。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说手机里有护照复印件的照片，也已经发到邮箱备份了；你还问这份报案记录多久能拿到、要几份。
turns.en: Yes — I keep a photocopy of my passport on my phone, and another in my email. How soon can I get the police report, and can I have two copies?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Marek
turns.en: Signed copy in twenty minutes. One for the insurer, one for your consulate. Anything else stolen — cards? Cancel them now, use our phone if you need.
turns.zh: 签好字的副本二十分钟后给您。一份给保险公司，一份给领事馆。还有什么被偷的——银行卡？现在就挂失，需要的话可以用我们的电话。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认卡已经在手机银行里冻结了，并向他要了报案编号，方便保险那边随时查询。
turns.en: The cards are already frozen in my banking app. Could I also get the report number, so my insurance can look the case up directly?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Consulate staff
turns.en: (at the consulate) With the police report and the passport photo, we can issue an emergency travel document. Two photos, one form, and it is valid for your flight home on Sunday.
turns.zh: （在领事馆）有了报案证明和护照照片，我们可以给您签发紧急旅行证件。两张照片、一张表格，效期覆盖您周日回家的航班。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认限制条件：这张证件只能直飞回家、不能再去第三国，对吗？你原计划周六顺路去邻国一天，看来要取消。
turns.en: Just to confirm: the emergency travel document only gets me home — I can't use it for the side trip to the neighboring country on Saturday?

chunks.zh: 紧急旅行证件（护照丢了时临时发的）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Consulate staff
turns.en: Correct — direct route home only, and it is surrendered when you arrive. Back home you apply for a new passport with this document and the report.
turns.zh: 没错——只能直飞回国，抵达时要交回。回家后再用这份证件和报案证明去申办新护照。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你收尾：你把所有旅行证件今晚重新备份一遍——原件放酒店保险箱，出门只带复印件和手机照片，这次教训够了。
turns.en: Understood. From tonight, my travel documents live in the hotel safe; I carry only copies and phone photos. Lesson learned the expensive way.

chunks.zh: 旅行证件（护照、签证等统称）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Consulate staff
turns.en: Smart. Come at nine tomorrow with the photos; the document will be ready by noon. Enjoy what's left of your trip.
turns.zh: 明智。明天九点带照片来，证件中午就能好。祝您剩下的旅程愉快。

scenarios.title: 国外药店：描述症状、买对药
scenarios.setting: 旅行第二天，你晕船后又吹了空调，头疼、嗓子疼、浑身酸。你走进街角的药店，药剂师是 Anna。你不会当地语言，只能用英语把症状说准。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Anna (pharmacist)
turns.en: Hello. How can I help you today?
turns.zh: 您好。今天有什么可以帮您的？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你描述症状和起因：昨天坐船晕船、晚上空调吹了一夜，现在头疼、喉咙痛、肌肉酸，但没有发烧；你想要对症的非处方药。
turns.en: Hi. I got motion sickness on a boat yesterday, then slept under air conditioning all night. Now I have a headache, a sore throat, and aching muscles — no fever, though. What over-the-counter medicine would you recommend?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Anna (pharmacist)
turns.en: For the headache and aches, this one is standard. Are you allergic to anything? Do you take any other medicine regularly?
turns.zh: 头疼和酸痛的话，这一款是标准的。您对什么过敏吗？平时有长期服用的药吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你交代过敏史：你对青霉素过敏，对止痛药没有；平时不吃长期药。你问这款止痛药的剂量和能不能跟晕车药同吃。
turns.en: I'm allergic to penicillin, but painkillers have always been fine. No regular medicine. What's the dosage on this painkiller, and can I take it with motion sickness tablets?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Anna (pharmacist)
turns.en: One tablet, up to three times a day, with food. Yes, together is fine, but the sickness tablets cause drowsiness — no driving, and no slopes tomorrow, I'd say.
turns.zh: 一片，一天最多三次，随餐。一起吃可以，不过晕车药会让人犯困——别开车，我建议明天也别上雪道。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认吃法并多问一嘴：嗓子疼有没有含片；另外你明天的船程还要两个小时，晕船药是提前半小时吃、对吗？
turns.en: Got it: one with food, three a day max. And take twice a day was for the other box — not this one, right? Also, do you have lozenges for the throat?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Anna (pharmacist)
turns.en: Right, not this one. Lozenges are on that shelf, honey or menthol. And yes — the sickness pill thirty minutes before the boat, not when you already feel ill.
turns.zh: 对，不是这一个。含片在那个架子上，蜂蜜或薄荷的。晕船药是登船前三十分钟吃，不是已经难受了再吃。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你拿齐东西结账，最后确认一句总的用法你有没有理解错。
turns.en: Then I have everything: painkiller with food, lozenges as needed, sickness pill half an hour before the ferry. Thank you — the pharmacy near the hotel was closed, you saved my evening.

scenarios.title: 误了火车：站台改签实战
scenarios.setting: 你在欧洲旅行，行李寄存柜取东西耽误了十分钟，眼睁睁看着火车关门。你拉着箱子跑到车站服务台，工作人员是 Jonas。你那张还是特价票，心里没底。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Jonas (station staff)
turns.en: You look like the 14:05 just left without you. What happened?
turns.zh: 您看起来像是刚错过 14:05 那班车。发生什么了？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你老实承认：寄存柜排队耽误了，你误了火车；这是你的票——特价提前票，你想知道它是不是彻底作废了。
turns.en: Exactly that — the lockers had a queue and I missed the train by three minutes. This is my ticket, a saver fare. Is it completely worthless now?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Jonas (station staff)
turns.en: The saver fare is tied to that train, so normally yes. But there was a platform change at 13:50 that wasn't announced in English — that makes it our problem too. I can rebook you free.
turns.zh: 特价票是绑定车次的，一般确实作废。但 13:50 有过一次站台变更，没有英文广播——这也算我们的问题。我可以免费给您改签。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你抓住机会问清新车次：下一班可乘的是几点、哪个站台、要不要换乘。
turns.en: That's a relief. What's the next available train, which platform, and is it direct?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Jonas (station staff)
turns.en: 15:20 from platform six, direct, arrives 18:40. Your new ticket is printing. Keep this slip — it explains the free rebooking if the conductor asks.
turns.zh: 15:20，六站台，直达，18:40 到。新票在打印了。这张小条拿好——列车员问起来，它能说明这次免费改签。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认新票的有效性：这张票在新车次上就是有效票对吧？另外路上三小时，你想升一等车厢，差价多少、是在这里付还是车上付。
turns.en: So this is a valid ticket for the 15:20. One more thing: I'd like to upgrade to the first class carriage for the three hours — how much is the difference, here or on board?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Jonas (station staff)
turns.en: On board is fine; the train conductor charges fifteen for the upgrade. Seats in first are unreserved today, sit anywhere.
turns.zh: 车上付就行；列车员收十五的升舱费。今天一等座不对号，随便坐。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你收尾确认时间安排：你去站台边的咖啡店等到三点再上站台，站台号临走前再看一次大屏确认。
turns.en: Perfect. I'll wait in the café and double-check the platform number on the big screen before I go down. Thank you for the honest rebooking.

scenarios.title: 购物退税：商场办理到机场盖章
scenarios.setting: 旅行最后一天，你在一家大商场给家人买了相机和包，总价超过退税门槛。你在商场的退税服务台先办手续，工作人员是 Elena；第二天到机场海关，你还要完成最后一步。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Elena (store desk)
turns.en: You'd like the tax-free forms for these purchases? I need your passport and the receipts, please.
turns.zh: 您要办这些购物的免税表吗？请给我您的护照和收据。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你递上材料并问清规则：两个包和相机是三张小票、同一家商场，合并办可以吗；退税比例和到账方式也请她说一下。
turns.en: Here they are. Three receipts from this store — can they go on one form for tax-free shopping? And how much VAT refund do I get, and is it back to my card?

chunks.zh: 免税购物（商店里办退税的那种）
增值税退税（游客购物退税）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Elena (store desk)
turns.en: One form works; the refund is about twelve percent, back to the card in five to ten days — after customs stamps it at the airport. Goods must stay unused and in hand luggage if they ask to see them.
turns.zh: 一份表就可以；退税大约百分之十二，海关盖章后五到十天退到卡里。商品要保持未使用，如果海关要看，要在随身行李里。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认关键顺序：明天先去海关盖章、再去托运行李，对吗？要是先托运了相机，盖章这步就过不了。
turns.en: So the order tomorrow: get the customs stamp first, then check my bags — because if the camera is checked in, they can't inspect it and I lose the refund.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Elena (store desk)
turns.en: Exactly right. Keep every proof of purchase with the form in one envelope. At this airport, customs is before security, landside, desk four.
turns.zh: 完全正确。每张购买凭证都和表格放在一个信封里。这个机场的海关在安检之前、外侧区域，四号窗口。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你在机场海关完成最后一步：把信封递过去，说明你要给这份退税表盖章，相机在随身包里可以随时出示。
turns.en: (at the airport) Good morning — I need a customs stamp on this tax refund form. The camera is in my carry-on if you want to see it.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Customs officer
turns.en: Show me the camera, please... Serial matches the receipt. Stamp done. Drop the envelope in the blue box; the refund follows to your card.
turns.zh: 请把相机给我看一下……序列号和收据对得上。章盖好了。把信封投进蓝箱子，退款会打到您的卡里。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认没有遗漏：免税店里买的巧克力不需要这一步对吧——那是出发后在免税区买的，本来就不含税。
turns.en: One last check: the chocolate from the duty-free shop doesn't need any of this — it was already tax-free when I bought it airside, right?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Customs officer
turns.en: Correct — nothing to stamp for duty-free purchases. Safe flight home.
turns.zh: 对——免税商品不需要盖章。祝您飞行平安。

scenarios.title: 滑雪第一天：租装备 + 约教练
scenarios.setting: 你第一次滑雪，到了雪场山脚下的租赁店。店员 Petra 负责给你配装备，旁边的滑雪学校可以约课。你对装备一窍不通，全靠问清楚。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Petra (rental shop)
turns.en: Morning! Skiing or snowboarding, and for how many days?
turns.zh: 早上好！滑双板还是单板？租几天？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说明情况：双板、三天，完全新手；你要全套装备租赁，鞋码 42、身高 175，板长请她按新手推荐。
turns.en: Skis, three days, total beginner. I need full equipment rental — boots size forty-two, I'm a hundred seventy-five tall. Please suggest a beginner-friendly ski length.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Petra (rental shop)
turns.en: Shorter skis for learning, then. Try these boots — snug is right, painful is wrong. Walk around for two minutes.
turns.zh: 那就用短一点的学习板。试试这双雪靴——贴合是对的，疼就是错的。穿着走两分钟。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你试穿反馈：左脚大脚趾顶得慌，右脚正好；你想换大半码的左脚……其实两只都换大半码更稳妥。头盔租赁也加上。
turns.en: The left of these ski boots presses my big toe; the right is fine. Can I try both half a size up? And add helmet rental, please.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Petra (rental shop)
turns.en: Better? Now, passes and lessons are next door, but the short version: a three-day ski pass includes all lifts. The school runs group lessons at ten and two.
turns.zh: 好些了？通票和课程在隔壁，不过简短版：三天的滑雪通票包含所有缆车。学校十点和两点有团课。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你约课并问细节：你报明早十点的团课，缆车票包含在通票里对吧；新手第一天只在初级雪道活动，教练会带你们上去吗。
turns.en: I'll book the ten o'clock group lesson tomorrow. The lift ticket is part of the ski pass, right? And on day one we stay on the beginner slope with the instructor?

chunks.zh: 滑雪通票（缆车+雪场通行证）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ski instructor (next morning)
turns.en: Welcome to the ten o'clock group. Today: stopping, turning, and falling safely — in that order of importance. Nobody goes near the big lift until those three work.
turns.zh: 欢迎来到十点的团课。今天学：刹车、转弯、安全摔倒——按这个重要性顺序。这三样没学会，谁也不许碰大缆车。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你表态并问一个新手最怕的问题：摔倒了怎么站起来要先教——你可不想在初级雪道上像翻盖的乌龟。
turns.en: Deal. Please teach getting up after a fall early — I don't want to be a flipped turtle on the beginner slope all morning.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ski instructor (next morning)
turns.en: First lesson of the day, then. Sideways, skis across the slope, push up. You'll master it by lunch — everyone does, usually by falling a lot before lunch.
turns.zh: 那就作为今天第一课。侧身、雪板横着朝向坡面、手撑起来。午饭前你就能掌握——通常是因为午饭前摔得够多。

scenarios.title: 演唱会之夜：站票、暖场与安可
scenarios.setting: 出差到外地，正好赶上你喜欢的乐队巡演。你和同事买了普通入场的站票，提前到场。检票员、酒水台、散场——一晚的热闹都在这儿了。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Door staff
turns.en: Tickets, please. You're general admission — doors are open, the floor fills from the front. Wristbands at the next table.
turns.zh: 请出示票。你们是普通入场——门已经开了，内场从前面开始站。到旁边的桌子领手环。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认站票规则：凭手环今晚可以自由进出内场吗？开演前你想先去买杯喝的、再占位置。
turns.en: With the wristband, can general admission come and go from the floor? We'd like drinks first, then find a spot. Standing ticket strategy: hydrate, then commit.

chunks.zh: 普通入场（不指定座位、站票区）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Door staff
turns.en: In and out all night with the band on. Bar's to the left; there's a cover charge for the after-party upstairs later, but the show itself is all included.
turns.zh: 戴着手环整晚随便进出。酒吧在左边；楼上散场派对另收入场费，但演出本身全包了。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你和同事分工占位：你去买水，同事去音响台旁边占位——你听说那里的声音最好，顺便问暖场几点开始。
turns.en: I'll grab water; my friend will hold a spot by the sound desk — best sound in the house, they say. What time does the opening act start?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Friend (text, read aloud)
turns.en: (phone) Got us a spot, rail on the right side. The opening act is actually great — hurry back.
turns.zh: （手机消息）位置占好了，右侧栏杆边。暖场乐队意外地很棒——快回来。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 演出结束后，你和全场一起喊安可，并和同事感慨这一晚值回票价。
turns.en: (after the show) That was worth every cent. The live music, the crowd singing the old songs — and that encore, they played the one song I came for.

chunks.zh: 安可、返场（演出结束后再加演）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Friend
turns.en: Same time next tour? I'll get the tickets the day they drop this time — no resale markup for us.
turns.zh: 下次巡演还来？这次我开票当天就买——咱们可不当黄牛的冤大头。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你应约并收尾：下次提前买票、还是站票前排；今晚的照片你回去发他；楼上散场派对他要是想去，你就把入场费那份 AA 说清。
turns.en: Deal — standing near the rail again. I'll send you tonight's photos when I get back. If you want the after-party upstairs, the cover charge is on you this time.

chunks.zh: 入场费（酒吧/俱乐部收的门票钱）

scenarios.title: 退房结账：账单上多出没消费的项目
scenarios.setting: 退房时你看了一眼账单，发现多了两笔迷你吧消费和一笔停车费——你根本没开车。前台是 Marco，你赶着去机场，但这两笔钱不能稀里糊涂付了。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Marco (front desk)
turns.en: Checking out, room 1206? Your total is on the screen. Shall I charge the card on file?
turns.zh: 1206 房退房吗？您的总金额在屏幕上。就刷预留的那张卡吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你要求先看明细账单：先别刷卡，你想逐项看一遍明细——你对其中两笔有疑问。
turns.en: Before you charge anything, could I see the itemized bill, please? Two lines on it don't look like mine.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Marco (front desk)
turns.en: Of course, printing it now. Which lines concern you?
turns.zh: 当然，正在打印。您对哪两项有疑问？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你指出具体问题：周二晚上的两笔迷你吧消费——那晚你十一点才入住、直接睡了；还有停车费，你根本没租车，这趟是打车来的。
turns.en: These two minibar charges from Tuesday night — I checked in at eleven and went straight to bed. And a parking fee? I never had a car this trip; I took taxis.

chunks.zh: 迷你吧（房间里的小冰箱酒水）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Marco (front desk)
turns.en: The minibar sensor logs when items are lifted. Sometimes guests pick things up to read the label and it still charges. Let me check the housekeeping record for that night...
turns.zh: 迷你吧传感器记录的是物品被拿起的时间。有时客人拿起来看标签也会触发扣费。我查一下那晚的保洁记录……

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你等核对结果，同时守住底线：如果是传感器误触发就请删掉；确认之前，预授权先不要转成正式扣款。
turns.en: Please do. If it was the sensor, those lines should come off. And until it's sorted, don't convert the hold on the card into a final charge.

chunks.zh: 信用卡预授权（押金冻结）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Marco (front desk)
turns.en: You're right — housekeeping logged the minibar untouched that night, and there's no car registered to your room. Both charges are removed. This is your corrected final bill.
turns.zh: 您说得对——保洁记录显示那晚迷你吧没动过，您的房间也没登记车辆。两笔都删掉了。这是修正后的最终账单。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你再核对一遍并确认细节：服务费账单里已经包含，所以不需要再留现金小费了，对吗？修正版请发一份到你邮箱。
turns.en: Let me check the final bill once more... The service charge is already included, so no extra cash tip needed. Please email me the corrected copy.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Marco (front desk)
turns.en: Sent. And sorry for the sensor — enjoy the flight home.
turns.zh: 已发送。传感器误扣很抱歉——祝您返程愉快。

scenarios.title: 航班超售：在登机口谈一笔好补偿
scenarios.setting: 登机口广播：航班超售，征集自愿改签的乘客，初始 offer 是 200 美元代金券。你明天的行程不赶，但你清楚这个价格还会涨。你走到柜台，工作人员是 Rachel。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rachel (gate agent)
turns.en: We're oversold by four seats. First offer is a two-hundred-dollar voucher and the evening flight. Any interest before I raise it?
turns.zh: 我们超售了四个座位。第一轮 offer 是两百美元代金券加晚上的航班。我涨价之前，您有兴趣吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你表达有兴趣但把条件问清：你想知道现金和代金券的区别、晚班几点到、过夜的话酒店和餐食谁负责。
turns.en: Possibly. Before I give up my seat: is the compensation cash or travel credit? And if the evening flight gets me in too late, who covers the hotel and meals?

chunks.zh: 自愿让出座位（接受补偿改签）
旅行代金券（航司给的抵用额度）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rachel (gate agent)
turns.en: The voucher is credit with us, valid a year. Evening flight lands at eleven; no hotel needed unless it cancels. Cash only enters if we have to bump people involuntarily.
turns.zh: 代金券是我们家的额度，有效一年。晚班十一点落地；除非它取消，否则不需要酒店。只有当我们不得不强制请人下飞机时，才谈现金。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你点破博弈：强制补偿的法定标准比自愿价高得多，而且现在没人举手——说明价格不够。你等下一轮，但把底线说清。
turns.en: Then let me be honest: the flight is overbooked, nobody raised a hand, and involuntary compensation costs the airline far more. I'll wait for the next round — cash, or credit at a number worth my evening.

chunks.zh: 超售的（航班/酒店卖超了）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rachel (gate agent)
turns.en: You're not wrong. Give me five minutes... Okay: four hundred in credit, the evening flight, meal vouchers now, and if that flight slips past midnight, a hotel voucher too. That's my ceiling today.
turns.zh: 您说得对。给我五分钟……好：四百代金券、晚班航班、现在就给餐券；如果那班飞过零点，再加酒店券。这是我今天的上限了。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你再确认唯一的风险点：晚班如果取消，你是自动排到明天第一班、还是要自己来柜台抢位置。
turns.en: One risk to close: if the evening flight cancels, am I confirmed automatically on the first flight out tomorrow, or do I queue and pray?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rachel (gate agent)
turns.en: Automatically confirmed, seat assigned, it's in the system before you leave this desk. And the compensation voucher prints with your new boarding pass.
turns.zh: 自动确认、座位已定，您离开柜台之前就进系统了。补偿券会和新登机牌一起打印出来。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你成交并致谢，顺便提醒一句：代金券的有效期请打在券面上，你不想回去再打电话查。
turns.en: Deal. Print the compensation voucher with the expiry date on it, please — and thank you for negotiating like an adult.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rachel (gate agent)
turns.en: Done. Gate B4 at seven forty. Enjoy the meal vouchers — the place by security is genuinely good.
turns.zh: 办好了。七点四十在 B4 登机。餐券好好用——安检旁那家是真的不错。

scenarios.title: 租车小剐蹭：从现场到租车公司的完整处理
scenarios.setting: 自驾第三天，你在老城窄巷会车时蹭到了墙，对方没人受伤、其实根本没有“对方”——只有一面墙和你的右后门。你先打租车公司的协助热线，然后到还车门店当面处理，门店经理是 Luis。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Assistance line
turns.en: Roadside assistance. Is everyone safe? Tell me what happened.
turns.zh: 道路救援热线。大家都安全吗？说一下发生了什么。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你报告情况：没人受伤，只有车身损伤——右后门有一道划痕和一小块凹痕，是你自己在巷子里刮到墙的。你问接下来按什么流程走。
turns.en: Everyone's safe — no other car involved. I managed to scratch the car on a wall in a narrow lane: a scratch and a small dent on the rear door. It was my fault. What do I do next?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Assistance line
turns.en: Take photos of the damage, the wall, and the street. For any scrape, even without a second party, get a police statement at the nearest station — the insurer requires it. Then drive on; the car is fine.
turns.zh: 把损伤、墙和街道都拍下来。任何剐蹭、哪怕没有第二方，都要去最近的警局拿一份警方记录——保险公司要求有。之后车可以继续开，没问题。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认顺序：你现在就去警局做记录，还车时把记录和照片一起交；费用方面，你买的是全包险，免赔额是零，对吗。
turns.en: Photos done. I'll get the police statement today and bring it at return. And since I took the full package, my insurance excess should be zero — correct?

chunks.zh: 警方记录/笔录（事故备案）
保险免赔额（自付的那部分）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Luis (branch manager)
turns.en: (at return) I see the statement and the photos — timestamps match your call. Clean paperwork. With your coverage, the minor accident closes here: no charge, no deposit hold beyond tonight.
turns.zh: （还车时）记录和照片我都看到了——时间戳和您的来电对得上。材料很干净。有您的保险，这次小事故到此结案：不收费，押金冻结今晚之后也不再多留。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你要一份书面结案证明：请把“无费用结案”写成一封邮件发你，免得下个月账单上冒出什么你还要再解释一遍。
turns.en: Please send that in writing — 'minor accident closed with no charge' — so if anything appears on my statement next month, I have your email.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Luis (branch manager)
turns.en: One formality at the desk: sign the damage report — it states single vehicle, minor accident, no third party involved.
turns.zh: 柜台这边还有个手续：签一下损伤报告——上面写的是单车事故、小事故、无第三方。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你签字并总结一句：这个小事故的材料就齐了——照片、警方记录、再加上这份报告。
turns.en: Signed. So the minor accident is fully documented now: photos, the police statement, and this report.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Luis (branch manager)
turns.en: Sent already. For what it's worth: half our damage cases get messy only because drivers report late. You did it by the book.
turns.zh: 已经发了。说句实在的：我们一半的损伤纠纷变麻烦，只是因为驾驶员报备太晚。您是按规矩办的。

scenarios.title: 民宿货不对板：和房东交涉到平台介入
scenarios.setting: 你订的“海景两居室”到了之后发现：海景要趴窗才看得见一角、热水器是坏的、楼下就是酒吧街。你先在应用里联系房东 Hannah，谈不拢之后升级到平台客服。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Hannah (host, in-app message)
turns.en: Hi! The lockbox code is 4417. Hope you love the place — the view is my favorite part!
turns.zh: 嗨！钥匙盒密码是 4417。希望你喜欢这房子——景色是我最喜欢的部分！

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你入住一小时后发去第一条消息：礼貌但具体地列问题：热水没有、“海景”在照片里和实际差太多、酒吧噪音大到半夜；你问她热水今晚能不能修。
turns.en: Hi Hannah, we're in — self check-in worked. Three problems, honestly: there's no hot water, the 'sea view' is a corner of blue from one window, and the bar downstairs is loud. The flat is not as described. Can the hot water be fixed tonight?

chunks.zh: 自助入住（无接触拿钥匙）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Hannah (host, in-app message)
turns.en: The water heater needs a part; earliest is day after tomorrow. The view is exactly like the listing photo, taken from the balcony. Earplugs are in the drawer!
turns.zh: 热水器需要一个零件，最早后天。景色和房源照片完全一样，是从阳台拍的。抽屉里有耳塞！

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你把证据和诉求一次说清：阳台照片用的是广角、而且拍的是隔壁楼顶的角度；你不打算吵，只要求合理方案：前两晚没有热水给部分退款，否则你只能找平台客服处理。
turns.en: The listing photo was taken with a wide lens from the roof corner — I have side-by-side photos. I'm not looking for a fight: a partial refund for the nights without hot water, or I have to take this to platform support.

chunks.zh: 房源照片（挂出来的展示图）
平台客服（订房/订票平台的）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Platform support (phone)
turns.en: I can see the full message thread and your photos. The hot water and the view are both material differences. Here's what I can do: move you to a similar flat two streets away from tomorrow, refund tonight in full, and credit the difference.
turns.zh: 我能看到完整的聊天记录和您的照片。热水和景色都属于实质性差异。我这边能做的：明天把您换到两条街外一套类似的房子、今晚全额退款，差价用额度补给您。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你接受方案并确认细节：换房的入住方式还是密码盒吗？换房那天行李能不能先放新房、你们下午再正式入住；退款到账时间也请确认。
turns.en: That works. For the new flat: is it a lockbox again? And can our bags go in at noon while we move at four? Also, when does tonight's refund land?

chunks.zh: 钥匙密码盒（门口挂的那种）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Platform support (phone)
turns.en: Lockbox again, code by message at eleven. Bags at noon is fine. Refund hits your card in three to five days; I'll email the summary now.
turns.zh: 还是密码盒，十一点发您密码。中午放行李可以。退款三到五天到您的卡；我现在把处理摘要发您邮箱。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你向房东发最后一条消息收尾：不带情绪地说明平台已经处理、明早退房时会把钥匙放回盒子，也祝她把热水器修好——下一個客人就不用经历这些了。
turns.en: (final message to Hannah) Platform support has sorted us out. We'll leave the keys in the lockbox tomorrow by ten. I hope the heater gets fixed for the next guests.

chunks.zh: 钥匙密码盒（门口挂的那种）

scenarios.title: 入境边检：被多问了几句怎么答
scenarios.setting: 你抵达一个新国家，边检官 Officer Grant 看了你的护照后没有马上盖章，而是开始问问题。队伍在你身后变长，你的心跳有点快——但其实你材料齐全，只要答得清楚、简短、一致。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Grant
turns.en: Passport, please. What is the purpose of your visit?
turns.zh: 请出示护照。您此行的目的是什么？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你按规矩答：一个词先行，再给具体天数和城市，别展开人生故事。
turns.en: Tourism — to answer the purpose of your visit question in full: ten days, four here in the capital, two at the coast, then back here.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Grant
turns.en: Where will you be staying?
turns.zh: 您住在哪里？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你答第一家酒店的名字和街区，手机上预订确认随时能出示。
turns.en: The Meridian Hotel, in the old town, for the first four nights. I have the booking here if you need it — that's the address of stay on my form.

chunks.zh: 住宿地址（入境卡上填的）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Grant
turns.en: Do you have a return ticket?
turns.zh: 您有返程票吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你出示返程票：周日晚上飞回国的航班，手机里有离线保存的预订信息。
turns.en: Yes — a return ticket for Sunday night, and the booking is saved offline on my phone. Here it is.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Grant
turns.en: How much money are you carrying, and how will you support yourself?
turns.zh: 您带了多少钱？靠什么负担这趟行程？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你答现金数额并说明有卡和手机银行余额可以当场给他看——资金证明就在手机里。
turns.en: About four hundred in cash, and my cards. I can show proof of funds in my banking app right now if you'd like.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Grant
turns.en: And the full itinerary — what are you doing day by day?
turns.zh: 完整的行程呢——每天都做什么？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你简明扼要地报行程：头四天本市的景点、第五天坐火车去海边、最后两天回来购物，机票和酒店都对得上，并表明细节都在备忘录里。
turns.en: Days one to four, sightseeing here. Day five, the train to the coast for two nights. Back here for the last two days — my itinerary matches the hotel bookings; the details are in my notes.

chunks.zh: 行程（安排好的一天一天的计划）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Grant
turns.en: (stamps the passport) Enjoy your stay. Keep the return booking handy for the airline on departure day.
turns.zh: （盖章）祝您停留愉快。返程那天航空公司可能还要看返程预订，留着方便打开。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你礼貌收尾离开柜台，心里复盘一句：他的问题一个都不难，难的是紧张的时候把答案说短、说一致。
turns.en: Thank you, officer. (to yourself) Every answer short, every answer consistent — that's the whole game at border control.

scenarios.title: 音乐节三天：营地、手环与最后一班车
scenarios.setting: 三天两夜的户外音乐节。你和两个朋友开车来，扎营在 B 区。入场、充值、看压轴、散场——音乐节生存全靠提前知道规则，同行的 Mia 是老手。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Mia (friend)
turns.en: We got a great campsite pitch — flat, near the water points, far from the generator. Tent up first, then wristbands, then beer. In that order.
turns.zh: 咱们这个营位不错——平整、离取水点近、离发电机远。先搭帐篷，再领手环，再喝啤酒。这个顺序不能变。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你认领任务并问清手环的用法：你去领三个人的手环；听说场内全是无现金消费，手环要先充值、在哪里充、剩下的钱退不退你要问明白。
turns.en: I'll grab the wristbands. Everything inside is cashless, right? Where do I top up the wristband, and do leftover balances come back afterwards?

chunks.zh: 给手环充值（音乐节无现金支付）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Mia (friend)
turns.en: App or the booths by the gate. Leftovers refund automatically, minus a small fee, in about two weeks. Top up small, top up often.
turns.zh: 用应用或者大门边的 booth 都行。余额自动退、扣一点手续费、大概两周。少量多次充，这是规矩。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你规划今晚的看演顺序：主舞台的压轴乐队十点才上，你们先去小舞台看七点那支，九点回来占位置；中间吃饭错峰。
turns.en: Tonight's plan: the small stage at seven, back here by nine to claim spots — the headliner doesn't start until ten. Dinner in between, before the rush.

chunks.zh: 压轴主演（音乐节的最大牌）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Mia (friend)
turns.en: Good plan. One survival rule: the shuttle bus line at closing is a war zone. Either leave during the last song, or stay for the silent disco and take the one a.m. bus.
turns.zh: 好计划。再加一条生存守则：散场时的接驳车队伍是战场。要么最后一首歌时就撤，要么去玩静音迪斯科、坐凌晨一点那班车。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你选后者并把集合规则定死：如果走散，就回营地集合，不在人群里互相找——手机在音乐节第三天基本是砖。
turns.en: Silent disco and the late shuttle bus, then. And if we get separated: meet back at the tent, not wandering the crowd. Phones are bricks by day three anyway.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Mia (friend)
turns.en: Agreed. Now — tent, wristbands, beer. A festival done right is just logistics with better music.
turns.zh: 同意。现在——帐篷、手环、啤酒。办得好的音乐节，本质就是物流配上了更好的音乐。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你笑着补充一句对营位的评价收尾。
turns.en: And this campsite pitch is the best logistics of all: close enough to hear the soundcheck, far enough to sleep through it.

chunks.zh: 营位（露营地里划给你的一块地）

scenarios.title: 滑雪后的温泉之夜：预订与礼仪
scenarios.setting: 滑雪第二天傍晚，你浑身酸痛，想去镇上最有名的温泉酒店泡汤外加做个按摩。你打电话到水疗中心前台，接电话的是 Yui，她把规矩讲得很清楚。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Yui (spa desk)
turns.en: Good evening, Sakura Spa. The public hot spring is open until ten; treatments need a booking. How can I help?
turns.zh: 晚上好，这里是 Sakura 水疗中心。公共温泉开到十点，理疗项目需要预订。有什么可以帮您？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你预订按摩并确认温泉开放方式：你要今晚七点的六十分钟深层按摩，用你的名字预订；温泉是男女分开的裸汤，第一次来，你先把礼仪问清楚。
turns.en: I'd like a sixty-minute deep tissue massage treatment at seven, booking under my name, please. And about the hot spring — it's my first time. What are the rules I should know?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Yui (spa desk)
turns.en: Wash fully at the showers before entering the water — no swimsuits, no towels in the bath. Small towel stays on your head or the side. Tattoos are fine here with a cover sticker from the desk.
turns.zh: 进水之前先在淋浴区把身体洗净——不能穿泳衣、毛巾不能进池。小毛巾可以放在头上或池边。有纹身的话，在前台领一张遮盖贴就可以。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你复述确认顺序：先洗净、再泡汤、按摩排在泡汤之后还是之前更好，你问她的专业建议。
turns.en: So: shower first, soak after, and nothing in the water but people. Should the massage come before or after the hot spring soak, in your professional opinion?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Yui (spa desk)
turns.en: Soak first — twenty minutes loosens the muscles, then the treatment works deeper. Your booking is at seven; arrive by six fifteen for the bath.
turns.zh: 先泡——二十分钟让肌肉松开，之后的按摩效果更深。您订的是七点，请六点一刻到，先泡汤。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认收尾：六点一刻到、带房卡可以把费用记在房账上，对吗？另外泡完之后二楼休息区可以躺到几点，你想把今晚彻底放空。
turns.en: I'll be there at six fifteen. Can I charge it to my room with the key card? And until what time can I use the lounge upstairs after? Tonight's plan is total collapse.

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你再问两个小规矩：温泉区里能不能拍照、泡完之后在哪里补水——你滑雪后总是忘记喝水。
turns.en: Two small rules more: can I take photos inside the hot spring area? And where do I get drinking water afterwards — I always forget to hydrate after skiing.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Yui (spa desk)
turns.en: No photos anywhere in the bath area, phones stay in the locker. Water and tea are free at the entrance — drink before and after, skiers are always drier than they think.
turns.zh: 浴区内禁止拍照，手机要留在储物柜里。入口处有免费的水和茶——泡前泡后都喝一点，滑雪的人总是比自以为的更缺水。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Yui (spa desk)
turns.en: Room charge is fine with the key card. The lounge is open until eleven — most skiers fall asleep there by nine, we consider it a compliment.
turns.zh: 房卡记账可以。休息区开放到十一点——大多数滑雪客九点就在那儿睡着了，我们把这当作夸奖。

scenarios.title: 自驾被警察拦下：一场超速的对话
scenarios.setting: 自驾途中一段限速 90 的乡间公路，你开着租来的车，仪表盘显示 108。身后警灯亮起。你深吸一口气，把车停到路肩宽敞处， Officer Davis 走到窗边。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Davis
turns.en: Evening. License and registration, please. Do you know why I stopped you?
turns.zh: 晚上好。请出示驾照和行驶证。您知道我为什么拦您吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你规范应对：手放在方向盘上、先说明你要去手套箱拿证件，回答问题不绕弯：你猜是速度——这段路你以为限速更高。
turns.en: Evening, officer. My license and registration are in the glove box — I'll reach for them slowly. I imagine it's my speed; I believed the limit was higher on this stretch.

chunks.zh: 驾照和行驶证（警察的固定说法）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Davis
turns.en: It's ninety here; I clocked you at one hundred eight. This is a rental? The paperwork is in order. Where are you headed tonight?
turns.zh: 这里限速九十，我测到您一百零八。这是租的车？文件没问题。您今晚去哪儿？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你如实交代行程并认下这个错：你们去湖边的酒店、还有半小时路，这是第一天开这辆车，不熟悉它的加速；不是借口，只是说明，但罚单你认。
turns.en: To a hotel by the lake, thirty minutes away. First day with this rental car and I misjudged its acceleration. That's an explanation, not an excuse — if there's a speeding ticket, I accept it.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Davis
turns.en: Here's how it works: the ticket is a fine, payable online within thirty days; the rental company gets notified and adds an admin fee. Nothing to pay roadside. Understood?
turns.zh: 流程是这样：罚单在线缴、三十天内付清；租车公司会收到通知、加收一笔管理费。路边不需要付任何东西。听明白了吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你复述确认避免误会：你在线付罚款、租车公司另收管理费、总额你回去看邮件；然后问一句现在能不能继续上路、后面这段路的限速是多少。
turns.en: Understood — and for the record, I did pull over at the first wide shoulder I saw. Fine online in thirty days, rental fee on top. Am I free to drive on, and what's the limit for the rest of this road, so I set the cruise control right?

chunks.zh: 靠边停车（被警察示意或主动）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Officer Davis
turns.en: Ninety until the lake junction, then fifty through the village. Slow down and enjoy the lake — it's prettier than the ticket.
turns.zh: 到湖边岔口之前都是九十，进村后五十。开慢点，好好享受湖景——它比罚单好看多了。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你道谢并把车速定在限速内继续上路，在心里把这次教训标价：这张罚单的价格，够在湖边吃两顿好的了。
turns.en: Thank you, officer. Lesson priced and learned — that speeding ticket just cost me two nice dinners at the lake.

scenarios.title: 和旅伴改计划：分歧怎么商量
scenarios.setting: 旅行第五天早餐桌上。你想去邻市的汽车博物馆，同行的老友 Chen 想睡到中午再去逛本地市集。两个人的预算和体力都见底了，这场对话决定今天怎么过——以及后面三天怎么过。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Chen (travel companion)
turns.en: I'm going to say it: I'm museumed out. Today I want a slow morning and the local market. Your car museum is two trains away.
turns.zh: 我直说了：博物馆我已经看够了。今天我想睡个懒觉、逛逛本地市集。你的汽车博物馆要倒两趟车。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你不硬碰硬，先把真实分歧点出来：你不是非去不可，你怕的是后面三天都变成“睡到中午”，行程会废掉；你们需要的是一个对双方都公平的改法。
turns.en: Fair — and I'm not married to the museum. My fear is the next three days becoming 'sleep till noon' by default. Let's find a change of plans that doesn't quietly delete the trip.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Chen (travel companion)
turns.en: What if today is slow — market, long lunch, nap — and tomorrow we do your museum first thing, when I'm human again?
turns.zh: 这样行不行：今天就慢节奏——市集、长午餐、睡午觉；明天我恢复成人了，第一件事就去你的博物馆？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你接受框架、再加一条分头行动的选项：今天他睡他的、你自己去逛旧城的市集，下午分头行动、六点在酒店集合交换战利品，谁也不迁就谁。
turns.en: Deal — and even better: this afternoon we split up for the afternoon entirely. You nap, I do the old-town market solo. Meet back at the hotel at six and compare treasures.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Chen (travel companion)
turns.en: Sold. Now the money talk before it gets weird: we're at about eighty percent of the travel budget, and the big dinner is still coming.
turns.zh: 成交。再把钱的事在变尴尬之前说清：旅行预算已经花了八成，那顿大餐还没吃呢。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你提出预算处理方案：大餐是全程唯一一次放纵，按原计划去；省钱从交通里出——明天去博物馆拼车改大巴，差价正好覆盖。
turns.en: The big dinner is our one splurge on this trip — we keep it. We save on transport instead: the bus to the museum tomorrow instead of the train-and-taxi combo covers the difference in the travel budget.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Chen (travel companion)
turns.en: A travel companion who trades trains for dinners. This is why we've survived five trips. Museum tomorrow, nine sharp — I'll even set my own alarm.
turns.zh: 一个肯用火车换晚餐的旅伴。难怪我们一起旅行五次都没散。明天博物馆、九点整——我连自己的闹钟都设好。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你用一句总结给这场协商收尾：计划就是用来改的，人才是要保住的。
turns.en: Plans are made to be edited; travel companions are not. Nine sharp it is.

scenarios.title: 在美国结账：小费到底怎么给
scenarios.setting: 你在纽约和当地朋友 Ben 吃晚饭。账单来了，上面有税、有一栏空白的小费行。你听说美国小费规矩多，正好当场把这一课补上。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ben (friend)
turns.en: Bill's here. Before you panic: tax is in, tip is not. The empty line is where visitors quietly lose their dignity or their money.
turns.zh: 账单来了。先别慌：税含在里面了，小费没含。那行空白就是游客悄悄丢面子或者丢钱的地方。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你虚心请教当地规矩：这边的 小费文化 通常给多少个点、是按税前还是税后算、服务好坏怎么影响。
turns.en: Teach me the local tipping culture properly: what percentage is normal here, is it on the pre-tax amount, and how does service quality move it?

chunks.zh: 小费文化（一个地方给小费的规矩）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ben (friend)
turns.en: Eighteen to twenty on the pre-tax total is standard now. Twenty-five if they were great, fifteen and a quiet word if they weren't. Card or cash, both fine — cash lands faster with the staff.
turns.zh: 现在标准是税前的百分之十八到二十。服务特别好给二十五；不行的话十五，再小声说一句。刷卡现金都行——现金到员工手里更快。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你现场计算并确认：这顿税前 84，你给 20 个点就是 17 左右，凑整到 100 总额正好；你朋友那半也是同样的算法对吧。
turns.en: So on eighty-four pre-tax, twenty percent is about seventeen — I'll round up and make it a hundred total. Same math for your half, right?

chunks.zh: 凑整（付钱时抹到整数多给一点）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ben (friend)
turns.en: Exactly. And because the waiter comped our dessert after the long wait, this is where regulars tip generously on top — the generous part is what gets remembered.
turns.zh: 没错。而且服务员因为让我们等太久免了甜点钱——这种地方老客人会在标准之外给得大方点，被记住的正是这份大方。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你拍板并把这一课总结成自己能记住的版本：查清是否含服务费、按税前算、好服务向上凑，全国通用、细节再问本地人。
turns.en: Done: tip generously tonight, he earned it. My rule from now on — check whether it's service included, do the math on pre-tax, and ask a local when in doubt.

chunks.zh: 服务费已含（账单里写明了）

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你再问两个边缘情况：酒保送的免费酒还要不要给小费、酒店保洁和行李员怎么算。
turns.en: Two edge cases: if a drink is on the house, do I still tip on it? And the hotel housekeeper and the man who carried our bags?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ben (friend)
turns.en: Tip on a free drink as if you'd paid — the gesture is the point. Housekeeping: a few dollars on the pillow each morning, not one lump at the end; they change daily. Bags: two per bag.
turns.zh: 免费的酒也要照付了的样子给小费——心意才是重点。保洁：每天早上在枕头上放几美元、不要最后一次性给，他们每天换人。行李：一件两美元。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ben (friend)
turns.en: That's the whole religion. Next lesson is the coat check and the valet stand — small bills, ready in hand, no fumbling.
turns.zh: 这就是全部教义了。下一课是衣帽间和代客泊车——小额钞票、提前拿在手里、不要翻包。

scenarios.title: 集市砍价：一场有节奏的游戏
scenarios.setting: 你在手工艺品市场看中一条手工围巾。摊主 Amara 开价 60。你喜欢它，但你知道这个价格里有给游客的水分——砍价在这里是礼仪，不是冒犯。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Amara (stall owner)
turns.en: Handwoven, madame, three days of work. For you, sixty.
turns.zh: 手工织的，女士，三天的工作量。给您，六十。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你先夸手艺再进入游戏：围巾确实漂亮、颜色也对，但 60 超出你的预算；你按规矩还一个价：30，各退一步看能不能谈。
turns.en: It's beautiful work, and the color is exactly right. Sixty is beyond my budget though — could you do thirty? Let's haggle over the price a little.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Amara (stall owner)
turns.en: Thirty is what the machine-made ones cost at the airport! This is wool from my sister's sheep. Fifty-five, and I am being generous.
turns.zh: 三十是机场卖的机器织的价格！这是我姐姐家羊的羊毛。五十五，我已经很慷慨了。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你还价有进有退：你指出开价是卖方的位置、不是判决；你出 40——这在当地算这条围巾的公道价，而且你付现金、不用她找零。
turns.en: The asking price is a starting point, not a verdict. Forty is my offer — a fair price for this scarf here, in cash, no change needed.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Amara (stall owner)
turns.en: Cash... forty-five, final. And I will tell you which stall sells your friend's ceramics without the tourist tax.
turns.zh: 现金的话……四十五，最后的价格。我还可以告诉你，哪家摊卖你朋友想要的陶瓷、不收游客税。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你成交并把气氛收圆：45 成交，你再多买一副手套凑个整，条件是她兑现陶瓷摊的情报——砍价的乐趣本来就在这后半段。
turns.en: Deal at forty-five. I'll add the gloves too — this beats the airport souvenir shop in every way. And I accept the ceramics intelligence as part of the bargain.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Amara (stall owner)
turns.en: You bargain like family. Gloves wrapped with the scarf. The ceramics man is Hassan, two rows down — say Amara sent you, it changes his arithmetic.
turns.zh: 您砍价像自家人。手套和围巾包在一起了。卖陶瓷的叫 Hassan、往下两排——说是我介绍的，他的算盘会不一样。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你最后打听一句：她织围巾的手艺是跟谁学的，她姐姐的羊场如果可以参观，那就是你明天的行程了。
turns.en: One last thing: where did you learn to weave? If your sister's farm takes visitors, that's tomorrow's day trip sorted.

chunks.zh: 一日游（当天往返的短途旅行）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Amara (stall owner)
turns.en: My grandmother taught me; the farm is twenty minutes by bus, and my sister feeds anyone who compliments the sheep. Go at nine, before the heat.
turns.zh: 我祖母教我的；羊场坐公交二十分钟，我姐姐会给任何夸她羊的人管饭。九点去，趁天还没热。

scenarios.title: 有人加塞：礼貌而坚定地开口
scenarios.setting: 火车站售票窗口前排着长队，你已经等了十五分钟。一个男人径直走到窗口前，假装没看见队伍。你深吸一口气，决定做那个“开口的人”——语气档位：客气提醒、点明事实、请他排队。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Man at the window
turns.en: (to the clerk) One ticket to the airport, fast — my train is in twenty minutes.
turns.zh: （对售票员说）一张去机场的票，快——我的车二十分钟后开。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 第一档：客气地假设他是没看见。你提醒他队伍从后面开始，你也在赶车，大家都是。
turns.en: Excuse me — the line starts back there, and most of us are also racing trains. The queue is easy to miss from this side.

chunks.zh: 不好意思，打扰一下……（开口搭话的万能起手）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Man at the window
turns.en: I'm only buying one ticket. It'll take thirty seconds. You people have time.
turns.zh: 我只买一张票。三十秒的事。你们有的是时间。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你升一档：把事实和平等原则说清，不吵不闹：每个人都是“只买一张票”，顺序就是这么保持的；请他等到轮到他。
turns.en: Everyone here is 'only buying one ticket' — that's how the line works. Please wait your turn like the rest of us; it moves fast.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Man at the window
turns.en: Mind your own business. (to the clerk) One ticket, please.
turns.zh: 管好你自己的事。（对售票员）一张票，谢谢。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你最后一档：坚定但礼貌，对售票员和平静地陈述——他刚刚插队到所有人前面，如果先卖给他，队伍的规矩就不存在了。你把决定权还给窗口。
turns.en: Sir, with respect: you did just cut in line in front of a dozen people. Clerk, I'll leave it to you — but if jumping the queue works here, the queue doesn't.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Clerk
turns.en: Sir, the line is over there. I'll serve you in turn. (to you) Next, please — airport as well?
turns.zh: 先生，队伍在那边。我会按顺序为您服务。（对你）下一位——也是去机场吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你收尾如常买票，不乘胜追击、不点评刚才的人——赢了规矩就够了。
turns.en: Yes, one to the airport, please. The 16:40 if there are seats left. Thank you for keeping it fair.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Older lady behind you
turns.en: (quietly) Well done. In this country everyone complains about jumpers and nobody speaks. You spoke.
turns.zh: （小声）干得漂亮。在这个国家，人人都抱怨插队，可没人开口。你开口了。

scenarios.title: 投诉三档：噪音问题从客气到强硬
scenarios.setting: 隔壁房间的派对吵到凌晨一点。你先后用了三档处理：给隔壁打电话客气提醒（没用）、打给前台坚定投诉（派人来了一次又复发）、最后亲自下楼向值班经理提出明确要求。今晚你练的是“分寸的档位”。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Neighbor (phone)
turns.en: Hello? Who is this?
turns.zh: 喂？哪位？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 第一档，最客气的说法：你自我介绍是隔壁房的，理解他们开心，只请他们把音量降一半——把要求放得具体又容易做到。
turns.en: Hi, I'm in the room next door. I know you're celebrating — congratulations, truly. Could you put it politely down a notch after one? Half volume would let the wall do the rest.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Neighbor (phone)
turns.en: Sure, sure. Sorry. (the music dips for ten minutes, then returns louder)
turns.zh: 好的好的，抱歉。（音乐小了十分钟，然后更大了）

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你打给前台，升到第二档：坚定但礼貌——陈述事实（凌晨一点、第二次了）、影响（你明早六点的航班）、和你想要的处理（请他们正式通知，并记录这次投诉）。
turns.en: Front desk, it's room 1206 again. Firm but polite: it's past one, this is the second time, and I have a six a.m. flight. Please make a formal visit and log the complaint.

chunks.zh: 坚定但礼貌（投诉的语气档位）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Night manager
turns.en: (in person, 30 minutes later) The party has resumed again, I hear it myself now. What would you like me to do?
turns.zh: （三十分钟后，亲自出现）派对又开始了，我自己都听得见。您希望我怎么处理？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 第三档：你不再满足于“再去提醒一次”，明确提出方案：要么他们立刻结束、要么给你换到安静楼层的房间并免今晚房费；你说这是你能接受的两个版本，没有第三个了。
turns.en: I'll speak up for myself plainly: either the party ends now, or you move me to a quiet floor and tonight is waived. A third reminder is not a solution — those are the two versions I can accept.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Night manager
turns.en: You're right, and I'm sorry it took two calls. The party ends now — our house rules are clear after midnight. And tonight is on us, with breakfast credit for the early start.
turns.zh: 您说得对，也很抱歉让您打了两次电话。派对现在就结束——我们的住客规矩写明了午夜之后的要求。今晚房费免了，再补一份早餐额度给您赶早班。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你接受处理并把关系收圆：你感谢他这次亲自上来解决，你投诉的是噪音和流程、不是他本人；明天退房时你会把这句写在评价里。
turns.en: Thank you — handled properly, finally. For the record, my complaint was about the noise and the process, not about you. Your house rules were clear all along; tonight they finally got enforced, and that is exactly the review I will write.

chunks.zh: 住客规矩（民宿/寄宿的规矩）

scenarios.title: 把旅行讲成故事：渡轮奇遇全记录
scenarios.setting: 回国后和朋友聚餐，朋友问“这趟怎么样”。你不想只会说“挺好的”，你要把渡轮那段讲成一个真正的故事：有起手、有反转、有高光。朋友小雨是个很好的听众，会追问。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Xiaoyu (friend)
turns.en: Okay, full report. How was the trip — and don't just say 'fine', I want the good stuff.
turns.zh: 好，全面汇报。这趟怎么样——别只说“挺好”，我要听精华。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你用讲故事的起手式开局：从最离谱的那段讲起——你绝对想不到，我们的渡轮在半路停了，原因是船长的女儿在对岸生孩子，全船人一起等了四十分钟。
turns.en: You won't believe this: our ferry stopped mid-crossing because the captain's daughter was giving birth on the other side, and the whole boat waited forty minutes for the news.

chunks.zh: 你绝对想不到（讲故事的起手式）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Xiaoyu (friend)
turns.en: No way. People must have been furious — missing connections and everything.
turns.zh: 不会吧。大家肯定气炸了——还要赶转乘什么的。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你往下铺垫：起初确实有人抱怨，但接下来发生了反转——船员打开了船上的小卖部免费发茶，有个老头拿出了手风琴。
turns.en: At first, yes. Then, out of nowhere, the crew opened the kiosk and handed out free tea, and an old man produced an accordion. It turned into a deck party.

chunks.zh: 毫无征兆地、突然冒出来

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Xiaoyu (friend)
turns.en: And the baby?
turns.zh: 那孩子呢？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你给出结局和高光：孩子出生了、全船鼓掌，船长通过广播说请全船吃冰淇淋；长话短说，那班晚点的渡轮成了整趟旅行的高光时刻。
turns.en: Born healthy — the whole boat applauded over the loudspeaker, and the captain put ice cream on his bill. Long story short: the delayed ferry became the highlight of the trip.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Xiaoyu (friend)
turns.en: That's the kind of story you can't plan. What else — give me the top three moments.
turns.zh: 这种故事是计划不出来的。还有呢——给我你的前三名时刻。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你顺手教她一个去的理由：前三里还有一段你先卖个关子，只留一句“你要是以后去，千万要在周日去那个小镇，具体原因吃完饭讲”。
turns.en: Number two involves a goat at a bus stop, which deserves its own telling. And if you ever go, be in the small town on a Sunday — reasons after dinner.

chunks.zh: 你以后要是去（给建议的开头）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Xiaoyu (friend)
turns.en: Deal. You tell stories like this now? The trip changed you.
turns.zh: 成交。你现在讲故事都这样了？这趟旅行改造了你。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你笑着承认：其实就是把顺序倒过来——先讲最好笑的那一下、细节随后补上，故事自己就会走路了。
turns.en: Honestly? I just learned to start with the plot twist and let the details catch up. The story walks by itself after that.

scenarios.title: 民宿主人深夜长谈：从茶聊到人生
scenarios.setting: 山间民宿的最后一晚。主人夫妇 Marco 和 Ana 在院子里泡茶，招呼你坐下。这一聊就到了半夜——从他们的创业史，聊到你为什么一个人旅行。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Marco (host)
turns.en: Sit, sit. The kettle is on. Guests who stay for tea get the real version of this valley, not the brochure one.
turns.zh: 坐，坐。水壶烧上了。留下来喝茶的客人，才能听到这个山谷真正的版本，不是宣传册上那个。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你落座并表达谢意：这三天民宿让你第二天早上就有了回家的感觉，这杯茶你等了一整天——其实是等了三天了。
turns.en: Gladly. This place made us feel at home by the second morning. I've been hoping for this tea for three days, honestly.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ana (host)
turns.en: We built this house when the road was still gravel. Marco wanted cows. I wanted guests. The guests won; the cows visit anyway.
turns.zh: 我们盖这栋房子时路还是碎石的。Marco 想养牛，我想接待客人。客人赢了；不过牛还是会自己来串门。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你和他们交换故事：你说自己在换工作的间隙出来走走，过去两年都是屏幕和会议；他们问起你的城市，你也讲了讲高楼里冬天的样子。
turns.en: We swapped lives tonight already. I'm between jobs and traveling while I can — two years of screens and standups. We swap stories properly: your valley for my winter city of towers.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Marco (host)
turns.en: Between jobs is not between lives, my friend. The road years count double. Ana, tell him about the winter the roof went.
turns.zh: 换工作的间隙不是人生的间隙，朋友。在路上的年份要算双倍。Ana，跟他讲讲屋顶被掀了的那个冬天。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你听完他们的故事后感慨：一见如故是真的存在——同样的书、同样的笑话、隔着半个地球。你们已经聊到半夜了，而茶壶还满着。
turns.en: You two are kindred spirits of mine — same books, same jokes, half a planet apart. We've managed to talk until midnight, and the kettle is somehow still full.

chunks.zh: 灵魂相通的人、一见如故的人

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ana (host)
turns.en: Then breakfast tomorrow is at nine, not eight, and nobody argues. Take the jam — the jar with your name is already packed.
turns.zh: 那明天的早餐改到九点、不许争。果酱带上——写着你名字的那罐已经包好了。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你道晚安时把这份情谊落实：明年你会带朋友回来；这之前，你先把答应他们的城市冬天的照片寄来，并请他们尝尝你寄的中国茶。
turns.en: Deal. Next year I return with friends — and I'll cook a home-cooked meal for this table in exchange, that's a promise. Until then: photos of my winter city, and Chinese tea by post.

scenarios.title: 酒吧拼桌：和陌生人聊开的一晚
scenarios.setting: 海边小镇的酒吧爆满，你端着酒找座位时，一张两人桌的本地姑娘 Sofia 招呼你拼桌。她是渔船领航员，刚结束一季的工作。陌生人之间的话题，要靠你一层层打开。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sofia (local)
turns.en: You can sit here — everyone ends up sharing on Fridays. I'm Sofia. In town for the boats or the beaches?
turns.zh: 你可以坐这里——周五大家最后都要拼桌。我是 Sofia。你来镇上是为了船还是为了海滩？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你坐下并自我介绍：两者都是，你在等明天的日出巡游；她问起你从哪来，你说了城市名，结果她接下来说出了一句让你愣住的话。
turns.en: Thanks — I'll happily share a table. I'm Zavier, in town for the boats and the beaches both; tomorrow's sunrise cruise is the plan. (She laughs at his city name: her brother drives a bus there.) Small world, genuinely.

chunks.zh: 拼桌（和陌生人同桌吃饭）
世界真小（异地遇熟人的感叹）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sofia (local)
turns.en: Ha! Then we drink to the bus routes of two cities. Tell me — what does a software man do in a fishing town in the off-season?
turns.zh: 哈！那我们为两座城市的公交线路干杯。说说看——一个做软件的人，淡季来渔村干什么？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你聊开自己：你在两个工作之间，专门挑淡季来，图的就是这种能和本地人慢慢说话的夜晚；你们一见如故，从渔船的夜班聊到代码的夜班，居然全对得上。
turns.en: Honestly, I'm between jobs and chose the off-season on purpose — for exactly this: slow evenings where locals actually talk. We clicked instantly, by the way: your night shifts at sea map perfectly onto my night shifts in incident channels.

chunks.zh: 我们一见如故、一下子就聊开了

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sofia (local)
turns.en: To night shifts, then. One local custom before the next round: here, the person who tells the best story doesn't pay for their drink. The floor is yours.
turns.zh: 那就为夜班干杯。下一轮之前先说一个当地习俗：这里讲故事讲得最好的人不用付自己那杯。你请讲。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你接招讲了渡轮那段，并守住自己的节奏：故事你来换酒，但喝的速度你说了算——你提醒她也提醒自己，今晚还长。
turns.en: A fine local custom — challenge accepted: one ferry story for one free drink. But I pace myself tonight; the sunrise cruise boards at five thirty and I intend to be vertical for it.

chunks.zh: 悠着点、控制节奏（喝酒/吃饭/游玩）

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你在欠下这个人情之前再打听一句：本地人休息日去哪儿——你想把明天下午过成当地人的样子，而不是游客的样子。
turns.en: Before I owe this table another story: what do locals do here on a free Sunday? Every town keeps a hidden gem the guidebooks miss — where is yours?

chunks.zh: 小众宝藏地（还没被游客发现的好地方）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sofia (local)
turns.en: The cove past the lighthouse — no signs, cold water, a grill if someone remembers charcoal. That's our hidden gem; tourists get the beach with the umbrellas.
turns.zh: 灯塔过去那个小海湾——没有路牌、水很凉、有人记得带炭就能烧烤。那是我们的秘密宝地；游客去的是有遮阳伞的那片沙滩。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Sofia (local)
turns.en: Wise. The story paid for itself at the accordion part. Sail with my cousin tomorrow — I'll text him; locals' price, and he knows where the dolphins actually are.
turns.zh: 聪明。你的故事讲到手风琴那段就已经值回酒钱了。明天跟我表哥的船出海吧——我给他发消息；本地人的价格，而且他知道海豚真正出没的地方。

scenarios.title: 去当地人家里吃饭：做客的规矩与温度
scenarios.setting: 民宿主人邀请你周日去他们家吃午饭——真正的家庭聚餐：祖母掌勺、三个孩子、一只狗。你带了一瓶酒和一束花。人到了，主人母亲 Rosa 在门口迎你。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rosa (grandmother)
turns.en: You came! Come in, come in. Shoes by the door, hands washed, and you sit here — next to me, so I can watch you eat.
turns.zh: 你来了！快进来，鞋放门口，手洗干净，你坐这儿——坐我旁边，我好看着你吃。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你按规矩入席并送上心意：花是给 Rosa 的、酒是给桌上的；你夸一句厨房的香味，并老老实实承认自己为这顿饭早饭只吃了个苹果。
turns.en: For you, Rosa — flowers. And the wine is for the table. I hear a generous host measures guests by appetite, so I arrived professionally hungry: one apple for breakfast, strategically.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rosa (grandmother)
turns.en: A guest who arrives hungry honors the cook. Start with the soup. In this house we raise a glass before the main dish, to health and to absent friends.
turns.zh: 饿着来的客人是给厨师面子。先喝汤。我们家的规矩是主菜之前先举杯——敬健康，也敬不在场的朋友。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你举杯并说祝酒词：敬健康、敬这张桌子、敬把陌生人变成客人的手艺；你说自己在学着像他们一样生活：慢、热、把人放在菜前面。
turns.en: To health, to this table, and to the art of turning strangers into guests. I'll raise a glass to that in any country.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Marco (host, from lunch scene)
turns.en: Careful — if you compliment the chef, she will feed you until the buttons surrender. The stew is her famous one.
turns.zh: 小心——你要是夸了厨师，她会喂你喂到扣子投降。这锅炖菜是她的名作。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你当场夸菜并付诸行动：这锅炖菜是你这次旅行吃过的最好的一餐，你说完就请 Rosa 再给添一份——行动比形容词诚实。
turns.en: Then let the buttons be warned: this stew is the best meal of my trip. Rosa, may I have a second helping? Compliments are cheap; appetite is honest.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Rosa (grandmother)
turns.en: A second helping! You may marry into this family. Sit, sit — coffee after, and you will tell us about your city while the little ones show you the dog's tricks.
turns.zh: 再来一份！你可以嫁进我们家了。坐好坐好——饭后有咖啡，你给我们讲讲你的城市，孩子们给你看狗的把戏。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你收尾道谢并把礼数学全：你帮着收了碗、把桌布的规矩也记住了；临走你请他们把合影发你一张，你要打印出来放在书桌上。
turns.en: Thank you for today — the food, the table manners lesson disguised as lunch, and a 'make yourself at home' that turned out to be literally true. Please send me the photo of us at the table; I'll print it for my desk.

chunks.zh: 别客气、就像在自己家一样

scenarios.title: 国外急诊：滑雪扭伤后的完整就医
scenarios.setting: 滑雪第三天，你在初级雪道摔了一跤，脚踝肿得像馒头，额头还蹭破了。朋友把你送到镇医院的急诊。分诊护士、医生、收费窗口——一套完整流程走下来。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Triage nurse
turns.en: Sit here, please. What happened, and where does it hurt most?
turns.zh: 请坐这里。发生了什么？哪里最疼？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你把受伤经过说清：滑雪摔倒、右脚踝扭伤、肿胀、不能完全负重，额头有擦伤；你没有药物过敏，但你要先声明这一点以防用药。
turns.en: I fell skiing an hour ago. It's a twisted ankle — right side, swollen, and I can't put full weight on it. There's also a cut on my forehead. No drug allergies, for the record.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Doctor
turns.en: We'll start with an X-ray scan of the ankle. The forehead cut is shallow; it may need two stitches after we clean it. Any medication you take regularly?
turns.zh: 我们先给脚踝拍 X 光片。额头的伤口不深，清洗后可能需要缝两针。您有长期服用的药吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你回答没有长期用药，并问费用的处理方式：你有旅行保险，这家医院能不能直付、还是你要先垫付再回去报销，你想在检查前问清楚。
turns.en: No regular medication. One question before the X-ray scan: I have travel insurance — can this hospital do direct billing, or do I pay first and claim later?

chunks.zh: 直付（医院直接和保险公司结算）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Doctor
turns.en: We can bill your insurer directly for the scan and treatment if you sign the form at the desk. The X-ray shows no fracture — a bad sprain. The cut needs three stitches and a tetanus update.
turns.zh: 如果您在前台签了表，检查和治疗我们可以直接和保险公司结算。X 光显示没有骨折——是严重扭伤。伤口需要缝三针，再补一针破伤风。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认治疗方案并问清后续：缝针没问题；扭伤这边是打固定还是只给拐杖、几天不能滑雪、拆线在家附近的诊所能不能拆。
turns.en: Stitches are fine. For the ankle: is it a brace and crutches? How many days off skiing — and can a clinic back home remove the stitches?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Doctor
turns.en: Brace, crutches, no skiing for a week — the holiday becomes cafés and museums, my friend. Stitches out in seven days, any clinic can do it. The desk will print your report for the insurer.
turns.zh: 固定支具、拐杖、一周不能滑雪——朋友，你的假期要变成咖啡馆和博物馆了。七天后拆线，任何诊所都可以。窗口会把给保险公司的报告打印给您。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你在收费窗口做最后确认：今天签了直付表，医疗账单就不从你卡里扣了对吗；报告和明细你都拿到了，回去的理赔就齐了。
turns.en: So with the direct billing form signed, the medical bill goes straight to the insurer, nothing from my card today. Report and itemized bill in hand — my emergency room visit paperwork is complete.

chunks.zh: 去急诊就诊（这件事本身）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Desk clerk
turns.en: Complete. Keep the brace receipt too — small out-of-pocket items still claim well with receipts.
turns.zh: 齐了。支具的小票也留好——小的自费项目有票一样好报销。

scenarios.title: 数字游民月租：看房谈合同
scenarios.setting: 你计划在一个海边城市远程办公住一个月。房东 Carlos 在应用上挂了一套“适合远程办公”的公寓，你去看房——你要问的不是风景，是网速、桌子和退出条款。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Carlos (landlord)
turns.en: Welcome! Two bedrooms, sea glimpse from the balcony, and the quiet street everyone wants. Rent is nine hundred a month. Questions?
turns.zh: 欢迎！两居室，阳台能瞥见海，还有大家都想要的安静街道。月租九百。有什么问题吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你直奔工作命脉：网速请他现场测速给你看，你每天有四个小时视频会议；还有那张桌子的椅子能不能换成有靠背的。
turns.en: The view is lovely, but my job lives on calls: could you run a speed test now? 'Fast wifi' needs to survive four hours of video meetings a day. And is there a chair with a back for that desk?

chunks.zh: 快网速（能开视频会的那种）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Carlos (landlord)
turns.en: Three hundred down, forty up — fiber. The chair I'll swap from my own flat. The coworking space two streets down is the backup everyone uses when the power blinks.
turns.zh: 下行三百、上行四十，光纤。椅子我从自己家搬一把过来。两条街外有家共享办公空间，停电时大家都去那儿当备份。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你谈价格和押金：你一次住满五周、提前付整月，月租能不能到八百二；押金多少、怎么退、几天到账，也要先说明白。
turns.en: Fiber sells it. For a five-week stay paid upfront, could the monthly rent come to eight twenty? And the security deposit (rental) — how much, and how and when does it come back? Good to know the coworking space is there as a backup, by the way.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Carlos (landlord)
turns.en: Eight twenty for five weeks, agreed. Deposit is one month, back by transfer within seven days of checkout if the flat is as you found it. Utilities are billed at cost with the meter photos.
turns.zh: 五周八百二，成交。押金一个月，退房后七天里转账退，前提是房子和入住时一样。水电按成本算，拍水表电表为准。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你问最关键的退出条款：如果工作变动你要提前两周走，租期怎么算——按天折算退剩余，还是整月不退。这个写进合同里你才签。
turns.en: Last critical point, the lease term: if work pulls me away two weeks early, is the rest refunded pro-rata, or lost? I need that in the contract before I sign.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Carlos (landlord)
turns.en: Pro-rata after week three, if you give notice two weeks ahead — I'll write it in. Furnished as you see it, plus the good chair. Deal?
turns.zh: 第三周之后按天折算，前提是提前两周通知——我写进合同。家具就是你看到的这些，再加那把好椅子。成交？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你成交并把手续说清：合同电子版发你邮箱、你今晚签；入住那天你们一起拍一遍房子的照片存档，省得退押金时扯皮。
turns.en: Deal. Send the contract tonight; I sign digitally. On move-in day we photograph the whole furnished apartment together — deposit peace for both of us.

chunks.zh: 带家具的公寓（拎包入住）
退租通知（提前告知搬走）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Carlos (landlord)
turns.en: Photos, meter readings, contract — a remote worker after my own heart. See you Friday with the good chair.
turns.zh: 照片、水表电表、合同——你是个对我胃口的远程工作者。周五见，我带着好椅子来。

scenarios.title: 跨国卧铺：包厢夜话与凌晨边检
scenarios.setting: 夜班卧铺火车从 A 国开往 B 国。你订了下铺，同包厢的是一位回老家探亲的退休教师 Ivan。凌晨三点，列车会在边境停靠查验。这一夜有故事，也有规矩。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ivan (compartment mate)
turns.en: Evening. You have the lower berth, lucky man. I am Ivan, going home to my grandchildren. Your bag can go under my seat if the rack is full.
turns.zh: 晚上好。您是下铺，幸运的人。我是 Ivan，回老家看孙辈。架子满了的话，您的包可以放我座位下面。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你道谢并回敬善意：你占了下铺的好位置，如果他夜里需要下来坐一会儿、或者想换一会儿，随时说；长夜漫漫，包厢里互相照应最重要。
turns.en: Thank you — and the lower berth is at your service if you want to sit properly for a while tonight. On a sleeper train, a good compartment mate is half the journey.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ivan (compartment mate)
turns.en: Kind. One warning from an old hand: the border stop at night comes at three. Officers take the passports, lights go on, nobody sleeps through it. Keep yours in the pillow pocket, not the suitcase.
turns.zh: 好意心领。老手提醒一句：夜间边境查验在三点。边检会收走护照、开大灯，没人能睡过去。把护照放枕头袋里，别放箱子里。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你确认流程并问细节：护照收走后会发回来吗、一般停多久、查验时能不能去洗手间——这些你不想凌晨三点现场发懵。
turns.en: Good warning. For the border stop at night: do they return passports to the compartment, or do we collect them? And how long is the stop, roughly?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Border officer
turns.en: (3 a.m.) Passports, please. (checks, stamps, returns them one by one) Thank you. Rest well.
turns.zh: （凌晨三点）请出示护照。（检查、盖章、逐个发还）谢谢。好好休息。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 查验过去后，你和 Ivan 都睡不着了，干脆泡了茶聊起来：他退休前教历史，你问他这个国家变化最大的十年是哪十年。
turns.en: (after the stop) Well, sleep is cancelled. Tea, Ivan? This sleeper train clearly runs on stories after 3 a.m. anyway. Tell me — you taught history: which ten years changed this country the most?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Ivan (compartment mate)
turns.en: Ah, now you ask the dangerous question at 3 a.m. — the answer takes exactly until our station. That is the secret timetable of night trains.
turns.zh: 啊，你在凌晨三点问这个危险的问题——答案的长度正好到我们下车。这个就是夜班火车的秘密时刻表。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你在故事里收尾这一夜：你把他的话记在手机备忘录里，你说这趟卧铺买的不只是交通，是一堂移动的历史课。
turns.en: Then the upper berth can wait — I'm taking notes. This sleeper train is turning into the best classroom of my trip.

scenarios.title: 保险索赔面谈：相机丢了之后
scenarios.setting: 你的相机在火车站被偷（报案记录已有）。回国后你按旅行保险流程提交了索赔，今天保险公司理赔员 Dana 打来核实电话。金额不小，她的问题会很细——你的材料齐不齐，决定了这一通电话的走向。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Dana (claims handler)
turns.en: Good morning, I'm calling about your claim number 4471 — the camera reported stolen on the fourteenth. Can you walk me through what happened?
turns.zh: 早上好，我是为 4471 号理赔案件打来的——您申报十四号被盗的那台相机。能给我讲一遍经过吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你按时间线陈述事实：十四号下午在中央车站，相机包在寄存柜旁被拿走；你当场报了警、拿到了报案记录，编号在理赔表里；车站失物招领处你也登记并确认没有找到。
turns.en: On the fourteenth, around 3 p.m., my camera bag was taken beside the lockers at Central Station. I reported it immediately — the police report number is on the claim form — and I checked the station's lost and found the same evening and the next morning.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Dana (claims handler)
turns.en: I have the report, thank you. What I need for the valuation: the original receipt, or a bank statement showing the purchase. The policy pays replacement cost for a like-for-like model.
turns.zh: 报案记录我收到了，谢谢。估值这边我需要：原始购买小票，或者能显示这笔消费的银行流水。保单按同款型号的重置成本赔付。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你递上材料并确认口径：购买时的电子发票你附在邮件里了，当时价格是去年的；重置成本按今年同款在售价格算，你查了官网价，比去年还低了一点，你按官网价申报的。
turns.en: The e-receipt is attached to my email from Tuesday. On replacement cost: I claimed today's price for the same model from the maker's store — slightly lower than what I paid, and I have the screenshot.

chunks.zh: 重置成本（按现在的价赔多少）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Dana (claims handler)
turns.en: That's exactly right, and refreshingly honest. One gap: the lens in the bag was declared separately on your valuables declaration — do you have its serial number photo?
turns.zh: 完全正确，而且诚实得少见。还差一样：包里那支镜头在您的贵重物品申报里是单独列的——您有它的序列号照片吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说有：出发前你给全套设备拍了序列号存在云相册里，链接你现在就能发她；另外问一句处理时长和结案方式，你好安排什么时候买替代机。
turns.en: I do — the lens was on my valuables declaration, and I photographed every serial number before the trip; the album link is coming to you now. And what's the processing time from here, and how does the case close?

chunks.zh: 贵重物品申报（投保/理赔时的清单）

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Dana (claims handler)
turns.en: With the serials, valuation completes this week. Payment lands within fifteen working days of approval, and you'll get a case closed email with the final amount and the appeal window. Anything else missing on your side?
turns.zh: 有了序列号，估值这周完成。批准后十五个工作日内打款，您会收到一封结案邮件、写明最终金额和申诉期限。您那边还有缺的材料吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你做最后确认并收尾：材料清单你逐项核对过——报案记录、发票、序列号、失物招领登记，全齐了；你引用案件号，请她有进展时用这个号给你发邮件。
turns.en: I've checked the list twice: police report, receipt, serials, lost and found record — complete. Please quote the claim number in any email. I look forward to the case closed email, and thank you for a painless process.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Dana (claims handler)
turns.en: Noted under 4471. Most claims drag on missing paper; yours arrived like a checklist. Expect the valuation email by Friday.
turns.zh: 记在 4471 号下了。大多数索赔都拖在缺材料上；您这份像清单一样齐。估值邮件周五前到。
